requirements_summary: SMB devtool: need hosted API (self-serve). Workload = high-rate code completions + occasional long-context search across codebases. Targets: median latency < 300ms for small completions, tail < 1s; throughput targets 200-1k reqs/min in spikes. Cost sensitivity: tight for seed-stage — prefer predictable per-request cost and recommendations to reduce token usage. Model prefs: open models ok but want model catalog and ability to pin versions; prefer models with 8k+ context. Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to smaller model on quota exceed. Security: SSO for team, audit logs, retention controls for customer data. SDKs: TypeScript + Go examples, streaming API for edits, easy batching utilities.
